strings.text: A bench under a street lamp. A place for two.
strings.translation: 가로등 아래 벤치. 두 사람을 위한 자리.

strings.text: Breath turns to steam. Only yours.
You came up to the bench. Death looked up at you.
strings.translation: 당신은 벤치로 다가갔다. 죽음이 고개를 들어 당신을 바라보았다.

strings.text: You sat down on the bench next to Death.
You sat down on the bench.
You walked away from the bench along the path.
Death walked off along the path and vanished beyond the lamps.
strings.translation: 죽음은 오솔길을 따라 걸어가 가로등들 너머로 사라졌다.
